title: Form-revealing fill: the unshadowed fills halved so wall bases, recesses and carved pieces keep their shade
why: Material-realism phase (2026-09-17), lighting response. On top of the 70,000 lux sun, LOOK02 left ~21,000 lux of UNSHADOWED directional fill (ground bounce 3,000 + two low canopy fills 9,000 each) that lit every recess, wall base and carved edge evenly, flattening the depth Lumen GI would otherwise give. Two variants at 8 identical cameras (evidence 2026-09-17-LT01): halving (kept) gives pedestals, facades and window recesses light-to-shade form while staying bright; cutting to ~6,500 lux total with a brighter sky light turned the hero pocket clock's shaded dial near-black and the street shade gloomy blue.
